title: Proud Grandmother Holding Newborn Baby, 1960s B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate black-and-white family snapshot capturing an elderly woman, likely a grandmother or great-grandmother, warmly smiling as she cradles a swaddled infant in her arms. She wears distinctive retro cat-eye glasses, a short pearl necklace, and a knit cardigan over a dark dress. The cozy domestic setting features a floral centerpiece on a table with a lace runner, patterned drapery, window blinds, and a potted houseplant.
